 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Minnesota Timberwolves seek their second NBA Cup victory when they take on the New Orleans Pelicans on Friday. The game begins at 8 PM ET and will air on KARE 11, DAZN-MIN, Gulf Coast Sports, and Pelicans+.
 The Timberwolves have won two straight, taking down the Houston Rockets, 117-107, in their latest contest. They are 6-3 on the season, putting them at 7th in the Western Conference. They are 1-0 in the NBA Cup, previously defeating the Los Angeles Clippers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Pelicans have won four straight after losing their first four games of the season, putting them at 4-4 on the year, 10th in the West. They are coming off back-to-back overtime victories over the Memphis Grizzlies and Utah Jazz. This is their first NBA Cup game.
 This is the first meeting of the season between the two teams.
 Minnesota Timberwolves Injury Report
 Terrence Shannon Jr. will be sidelined again with a left hip contusion. Shannon Jr. has been out since October 31. In seven games this season, he is averaging 12 points, 3.6 rebounds, and 2.6 assists.
 Anthony Edwards is OUT after undergoing right knee arthroscopy. On October 28, it was announced that he would be out for up to two months. He is averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, and 3.5 assists in four games this year.
 Sam Navarro-Imagn Images
 Donte DiVincenzo is OUT after undergoing right Achilles tendon surgery in April. He suffered the injury during game four of the NBA playoffs first round. He is hopeful to return at some point this season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Timberwolves will start Jaden McDaniels, Ayo Dosunmu, Rudy Gobert, Jonathan Kuminga , and LaMelo Ball .
 Jaylen Clark, Trey Lyles, Bones Hyland, and Joan Beringer are the top options off the bench.
 They have the 8th ranked offense and the 3rd ranked defense.
 New Orleans Pelicans Injury Report
 Trey Murphy III is PROBABLE with bilateral patellar tendinopathy. He missed the last game against the Jazz. He is averaging 14.9 points, 4.6 rebounds, and 3.4 assists in seven games this season.
 Yves Missi is OUT with a left knee contusion and bone bruise. He has played in only two games this season, averaging 9.5 points, 7.5 rebounds, and 2.5 assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Milak Dia, Jaron Pierre Jr., and Julian Reese are DOUBTFUL on G League two-way deals.
 With Murphy out of the lineup, the Pelicans started Dejounte Murray, Zion Williamson, Herbert Jones, Jeremiah Fears, and Karlo Matkovic against the Jazz.
 Saddiq Bey, Derik Queen, Trendon Watford, and Bennedict Mathurin all played more than 15 minutes in that game, with no other reserves being used.
 They have the 13th ranked offense and the 14th ranked defense.
